tasks.description: Read in/poem.txt. Write out/result.txt with the first word of each line, one per line, in order.

inputs.in/poem.txt:
Roses are red
violets are blue
sugar is sweet
AND so are you
the end

tasks.description: Read in/poem.txt. Write out/result.txt where every line has its words in reverse order (words are separated by single spaces).

inputs.in/poem.txt:
Roses are red
violets are blue
sugar is sweet
AND so are you
the end

tasks.expected:
red are Roses
blue are violets
sweet is sugar
you are so AND
end the

tasks.description: Read in/poem.txt. Write out/result.txt containing only the first 3 characters of every line, one per line.

inputs.in/poem.txt:
Roses are red
violets are blue
sugar is sweet
AND so are you
the end

tasks.description: Read in/poem.txt. Write out/result.txt with the lines sorted in ascending byte order (plain string comparison; uppercase sorts before lowercase).

inputs.in/poem.txt:
Roses are red
violets are blue
sugar is sweet
AND so are you
the end

tasks.expected:
AND so are you
Roses are red
sugar is sweet
the end
violets are blue

tasks.description: Read in/poem.txt. Write out/result.txt with only the lines whose word count is exactly 3, in input order.

inputs.in/poem.txt:

violets are blue
sugar is sweet
AND so are you
the end

tasks.expected:
Roses are red
violets are blue
sugar is sweet

tasks.description: Read in/stock.tsv (tab-separated, header row sku,qty,price). Write out/result.txt with the sku of every row whose integer qty is 0.
Read in/stock.tsv. Write out/result.txt containing the integer total value: the sum over rows of qty * price.
Read in/stock.tsv. Write out/result.txt with the sku of the row with the highest integer price.
Read in/stock.tsv. Write out/result.txt with the data rows (no header) sorted by sku in ascending string order, each row written back tab-separated.
Read in/stock.tsv. Write out/result.json: an object mapping each sku to its integer qty.
Read in/temps.txt (one line of comma-separated integers). Write out/result.txt with the integer difference between the largest and smallest value.
Read in/temps.txt. Write out/result.json: the JSON array of values that are strictly greater than the first value, in input order.
Read in/temps.txt. Write out/result.json: the JSON array of running totals (the i-th element is the sum of the first i+1 values).
Read in/temps.txt. Write out/result.txt with the 1-based position of the largest value (the first one on ties).
Read in/temps.txt. Write out/result.json: the values doubled, as a JSON array of integers in input order.
Read in/queue.json (array of strings). Write out/result.json: the last 3 elements, in their original order.
Read in/queue.json. Write out/result.txt with the 0-based index of the first "build", or -1 if absent.
Read in/queue.json. Write out/result.json: the distinct strings sorted in ascending string order.
Read in/queue.json. Write out/result.json: an object mapping each string to how many times it occurs.
Read in/queue.json. Write out/result.json: the array without its first and last elements.
Read in/path.txt (one Unix path). Write out/result.txt with the file extension without the dot (text after the last '.').
Read in/word.txt (one word). Write out/result.txt with "yes" if it reads the same reversed, else "no".
Read in/title.txt. Make a slug: trim, lower-case, split on single spaces, drop empty pieces, join with '-'. Write it to out/result.txt.
Read in/version.txt (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Write out/result.txt with the next minor version (minor + 1, patch reset to 0).
Read in/sentence.txt. Write out/result.txt with the longest word (the first one on ties).

inputs.in/sentence.txt: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

tasks.description: Read in/orders.json (array of {id, cust, total}). Write out/result.json: an object mapping each cust to the integer sum of their totals.
Read in/orders.json. Write out/result.txt with the ids of orders whose total is at least 100, one per line in input order.
Read in/orders.json. Write out/result.json: the array of distinct cust names in first-seen order.
Read in/orders.json. Write out/result.txt with the id of the order with the smallest total.
Read in/orders.json. Write out/result.json: {"count": number of orders, "total": integer sum of totals}.
Read in/n.txt (one integer n >= 1). Write out/result.txt with the FizzBuzz lines for 1..n: "FizzBuzz" for multiples of 15, "Fizz" for 3, "Buzz" for 5, else the number.

2
Fizz

tasks.description: Read in/brackets.txt (one line). Check (), [] and {} nesting. Write "ok" if balanced, "unclosed" if brackets remain open at the end, or "error at <i>" (0-based character index) at the first closing bracket that does not match.
Read in/grid.txt (rows of '#' and '.'). Write out/result.json: an array with the integer count of '#' in each row.
Read in/edges.txt (lines "x>y" forming one chain). Write out/result.txt with the chain from its start to its end joined by '>' (here the start is the only node that is never on the right).
